proves.claim: every gallery blueprint is bundled and valid.

blueprints.gallery.bundled-and-valid.why: A card that ships without its blueprint, or invalid, breaks the gallery.

proves.claim: every bundled starter item carries a criterion and a check.

blueprints.starter.criterion-and-check.why: A starter item with no check proves nothing once built.

proves.claim: bundled blueprint rows carry the checks they promise.

blueprints.rows.carry-checks.why: A row without its promised check silently weakens the blueprint.

proves.claim: every blueprints-cell test has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

blueprints.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: Every blueprints test file that reads files carries an input header naming the cells it reads.

blueprints.inputs.every-blueprints-test-.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: A declared header names only the blueprints cell, never the whole source tree.

blueprints.inputs.a-declared-header-name.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.

proves.claim: With the outside-src rule on, no blueprints test reads data or fixtures undeclared.

blueprints.inputs.with-the-outside-src-r.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.
